notes: Three rules. The approval and working rules were read off ZCode 4.0.0's TUI (CLI 0.18.0) in `zai-org/ZCode`; all three were then watched on CLI 0.18.0 in tmux, sampled every half second through a turn with a shell command and a write: the status line carries `esc to interrupt` (`activeStatusHint`), the tool-approval dialog offers `Allow once`, `Always allow in this project` and `Deny`, and the input box is titled with the mode (`formatInputModeLabel`). Its sign-in screen is not covered.

rules.note: ZCode's tool-approval dialog: `Allow once`, `Always allow in this project` (or `Always allow Computer Use in this project`) and `Deny`. Read off the 4.0.0 source and watched on 0.18.0.
ZCode's status hint while a turn runs, `activeStatusHint: "esc to interrupt"` in 4.0.0's en-US locale. Read off the source and watched on 0.18.0.

ZCode's input box, titled with the mode (`app-input-pane.tsx`'s `inputPaneTitle`, `Input` with none), waiting for a prompt. Mid-turn the same box says `Type to queue input` over an `esc to interrupt` status line, which the guards and the working rule's priority keep working. Watched on 0.18.0: without this rule a finished turn read `unknown`, which resets the wait before a session counts as waiting on you.
